experiment_title: Screening Of late Maturity Maize Entries Against Sorghum Downy Mildew
inference: In the evaluation of 42 entries, only two entries SMH 6333 and TMMH 2882 showed resistance to SDM, whereas ADV 7559 entry showed a moderately resistant reaction against SDM. Additionally, the entry NAH 1137 recorded a resistance level of 8.8% against SDM. On the other hand, the susceptible check, African Tall, exhibited a susceptibility level of 90.3%, indicating its vulnerability to the disease. These results underscore the presence of promising resistant entries that could contribute to the development of maize varieties with enhanced resistance characteristics.

experiment_title: Screening Of Specialty corn Maize Entries Against Sorghum Downy Mildew
inference: Among the evaluated 50 entries of specialty corn, only one entry, ASKH 4(C) showed resistance to SDM. The susceptible check, African Tall, demonstrated a susceptibility level of 95.5%, indicating its vulnerability to the disease. In contrast, the resistant check NAH 1137 recorded a resistance level of 7.8% against SDM. These findings highlight the absence of resistance in the evaluated specialty corn entries and emphasize the importance of incorporating resistant checks like MAH-14-138 in breeding programs for enhanced disease resistance.

experiment_title: Screening of Station inbred Maize Entries Against Sorghum Downy Mildew
inference: Among the 38 maize station inbreds, entries MAI-10-1, MAI 215, MAI-215-1, NAI-137-7, CML-451, MAI-729, and MAI-105 exhibited resistance to SDM, while entries MAI-224, MAI 753, CAL-1443, QPM 25, and 52336 were found to be moderately resistant. The resistant check, NAH 1137, recorded a resistance level of 9.8%, indicating its effectiveness against SDM. Additionally, the susceptible check, African Tall, showed complete susceptibility with a 100% disease incidence. These results provide insights into the resistance levels of the evaluated maize station inbreds, with NAH 1137 serving as a promising resistant check.
